subject: Post-call: Evidence intake, DPA redlines & pen-test artifacts
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@olivebank.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: evidence intake and retention requirements

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the time today. Wanted to recap the key pain points and asks from OliveBank's side so we have a single source of truth: 

- Compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II in-scope, plus regulator-driven audit requirements for transaction logs.
- Retention: primary ask is audit log retention for 7 years (transaction + access logs), with ability to export in ISO-8601 timestamps and export by account id.
- DPA/residency: we need EU data residency controls and a DPA with clear subprocessor list.
- Pen test artifacts: we need recent pen test summary reports and remediation evidence (we cannot accept raw vuln reports without an NDA — procurement/legal can advise).
- Evidence mapping: request for an intake spreadsheet that maps Redwood artifacts to our SOC 2/control framework and who owns each item.

Attached is our Evidence Intake Template (OliveBank_Evidence_Intake_Template_v1.xlsx). Please confirm next steps and owners. We expect an initial artifact handoff by EOD 2027-05-26 if possible so we can start internal review.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Third-Party Risk, OliveBank
security@olivebank.com

Attachment: OliveBank_Evidence_Intake_Template_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@olivebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evidence intake and retention requirements

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the clear summary and the template — that's extremely helpful. Recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

Summary of what Redwood will provide this week: 
- Evidence mapping: we'll populate your intake template with our artifacts mapped to SOC 2 Common Criteria (CC7, CC8, etc.) and call out gaps.
- Retention details: a short doc that explains log capture points, retention tiers (hot/warm/cold), and export procedures for account-scoped exports.
- Pen-test posture: we'll provide a pen-test executive summary and remediation timeline. Per your note, full raw reports require an NDA; we can share a sanitized digest today and discuss an NDA path for the raw reports with procurement.
- DPA/DSP: will provide our current DPA + subprocessor list and flag any clauses that typically get redlines (data residency, deletion SLA, audit rights).

Action items and owners: 
1) Logan Wright — populate intake template + evidence matrix (deliverable: redwood-evidence-matrix-template.csv) — target: 2027-05-26 EOD.
2) Rishi Malhotra — pen-test summary and remediation timeline + note on sensitive raw reports (deliverable: pen-test-summary.pdf) — target: 2027-05-26.
3) Laura Bennett — DPA and legal-touchpoint (will coordinate with Redwood legal for suggested redlines & timeline) — internal sync by 2027-05-25.

Links: I'll upload the matrix to the folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEvidenceMapping and will paste the hubspot record once updated: https://hubspot.example/contacts/OLIVE-231

If the dates are aggressive for your review cycle, let us know the first-date you can accept artifacts and we'll adjust.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-evidence-matrix-template.csv (csv, 12KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@olivebank.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evidence intake and retention requirements

Hi Marta —

Following up on Logan's plan with a technical framing from our side. A few clarifications and constraints to manage expectations: 

1) SOC 2 artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II report summary, control narratives, system inventory, change management logs (redacted), user access-review artifacts. I'll attach a short scope summary.
2) Audit logs & retention: logs are retained according to configurable retention policies. We can export account-scoped logs for the timeframe you request; exports will be in newline-delimited JSON with ISO timestamps. For 7-year retention we'll need to discuss storage tiering and egress costs — we'll include cost guidance in the matrix.
3) Pen test evidence: we will provide an executive summary PDF and remediation attestations. Full raw penetration test reports include customer-identifying detail and our vendor's findings; those are shared under NDA and on a secure file-transfer. If your procurement/legal can sign our standard mutual NDA (I'll loop in Legal), we can expedite.
4) DPA redlines: Laura will lead legal review. Commonly flagged clauses we see are deletion triggers, audit windows, and subprocessor disclosure cadence.

I've attached a short "soc2-scope-summary.pdf" that lists the controls in-scope and typical artifact types. We'll aim to get the populated intake template to you by EOD 2027-05-26.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Applied Security, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachment: soc2-scope-summary.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

Logan / Rishi —

Thank you both for the quick turnaround and the attachment. Our procurement and legal teams confirmed they can accept a sanitized pen-test digest for initial review; they'll coordinate an NDA for the full report (procurement@olivebank.com).

For the retention/export: we need an initial export sample and the export schema to be delivered to us by 2027-05-26 as you suggested. Can you confirm the export will include: 
- event timestamp (ISO-8601)
- account_id
- event_type
- source_host
- actor_id (redacted if internal system)

Also please include the workflow for deletion requests (how to request deletion for a customer, estimated completion SLA).

We'll look for the populated intake matrix in the Drive folder and will schedule a legal gating call next week after we've reviewed the artifacts. 

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Third-Party Risk, OliveBank
